new_roles.title: Director of S&OP and Production Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
At Taconic Biosciences, operational excellence fuels scientific discovery. We're seeking an experienced Operations Planning leader to strengthen the connection between commercial demand and operational execution, ensuring our teams deliver exceptional results for customers worldwide. If you're passionate about strategic planning, continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

**The Location:** This role is a primarily at home/remote but will have ad hoc needs to come onsite. Average monthly time on-site is 5% - 10%. A candidate residing within 2 hours of Albany, NY or Germantown, NY is preferred but not required.

**The Pay Range**: $120,000 - $170,000 annually. *Exact annual base salary may vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to: geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions.*

**The Schedule:** Monday - Friday, core business hours.

**What we offer:**

* Insurance within 30 days or less which includes options for medical, dental, vision, pet insurance and more!
* 20 days paid time off plus 6 additional holidays and 1 floating holiday
* Work life balance
* 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Career advancement opportunities
* Commitment to training and providing you with the skills you need for success
* All employees receive access to 24/7 telemedicine (including mental health), short- and long-term disability and life insurance

**The Role:** 
The role's objective is to strengthen alignment between Operations and the Commercial areas, making sure internal and external customers' expectations are met, as well as constantly improving efficiency & cost to achieve business financial commitments. 
 
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Manage and develop the SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) process across the business
* Ensure optimal communication among Commercial & Operations regarding demand and production commitments
* Develop and maintain updated Operational Capacity numbers, and timely detect capacity expansion needs
* Coordinator efforts to develop Operation's yearly budgets (AOP) and forecast updates
* Work closely with global Commercial Demand stakeholders (sales, marketing, R&D), Procurement, Animal Production and Logistics to align Operation's resources to demand
* Identify and highlight to OLT (Operations Leadership Team) any short-, mid-, and long-term resource needs based on commercial demand plans and changes
* Develop a LEAN Production culture that is constantly looking for improvement results in all metrics that matter considering, but not limited to: People, Safety, Quality, Animal Welfare, Customer Services and Cost
* Detect, develop and execute continuous improvement projects to optimize the use of Operation's resources; (5Ms - Men & Women, Machines, Materials, Minutes (time and schedules), Methods)
* Develop and implement success metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement
* Lead, manage and develop all members of the Operations Planning Team

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering or similar required, Master's degree is desirable
* Experience in the management of a professional staff and senior-level decision making
* Extensive experience in a specialized field, with responsibility for strategic technical direction, high-impact problem-solving, or enterprise-level initiatives
* 10+ years of relevant experience and/or training required
* Experience in Industrial Production/Manufacturing. Laboratory animal production would be desirable.
* Skill in designing, implementing, and coordinating projects.
* Experience in making strategic decisions or recommendations for improving or changing organizational policies, procedures and processes.
* Structured, well organized analytical thinking.
* 10+ years in any area of Industrial Operations areas.
* 6+ years in Production / Manufacturing
* 5+ years leading teams & experience in Change Management
* 3+ years in S&OP process including IBP (Integrated Business Planning) 
 Other Desirable Experience & Competencies:
* 3+ years managing Operations / Manufacturing Costs
* 3+ Years Project management experience (PMO)
* Knowledge and Practical experience with Forecasting Statistical Methodologies
* APICS certification
* AI experienced applied to S&OP
* Multi site / Global responsibility.

**Allergen Disclosure:**

Due to the nature of the work performed at Taconic, employees may be exposed to allergens in the workplace, even if their positions do not involve the direct handling of animals or animal bedding. While individuals with preexisting allergies and/or asthma may be particularly sensitive to these exposures, anyone can experience a reaction.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment:**

The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work, with some walking; standing; bending; carrying of items such as papers, books, small parts; driving an automobile; etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

**About Us:** 
With a history of over 70 years of excellence, Taconic Biosciences is a global team of the best problem solvers in the industry. We partner with our clients to develop winning research strategies that accelerate the discoveries for prevention and treatment of disease.

Taconic employees all over the world show up every day to deliver the best solutions for our clients while caring for ourselves, each other, and especially our animals. If you are a respectful, compassionate individual with a can-do attitude and a desire to do the right thing, we want you to join us!

**Better Together at Taconic** 
Awareness, Action, & Respect. Taconic Biosciences is taking an active and intentional role in fostering a company culture that values and appreciates the uniqueness of all individuals, by promoting fairness and equity. Being you is what allows you to bring your best self to work. We are committed to making Taconic a safe and fair workplace for everyone. We are better together. 
 
Taconic Biosciences is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, and all other categories protected by law.

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career. Lead With Precision.**

Nammo Perry is a center of excellence for the design, development and production of munitions and pyrotechnic products for the U.S. Department of Defense. Nammo employees working at the Florida site manufacture all types of 40mm low and high velocity ammunition; pyrotechnic marking; signaling and tactical illumination devices; battlefield effects training simulators; demolition charges; hand grenade fuzes; and other ammunition components. Additionally, they provide load, assemble, and pack (LAP) services for large caliber direct-fire ammunition.

The **Director of Operations** provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing, energetic material processing, maintenance, and facilities functions across the Nammo Perry facility. Reporting directly to the Site President/General Manager this position is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and reliable operations while supporting organizational growth production readiness and long-term business objectives.

The Director of Operations leads a multidisciplinary organization through direct-report managers responsible for Energetic Operations, Production Operations, Maintenance, and Facilities. These functions collectively support the site's manufacturing capabilities, critical infrastructure, equipment reliability, and operational continuity. The Director of Operations is expected to establish clear operational priorities, develop strong management teams, drive accountability, and foster a culture of continuous improvement grounded in Nammo’s core values of Dedication, Care, and Precision.

**Unique Benefits Designed with Care:**

* Monday - Thursday work week working 10-hour days
* Relocation assistance provided
* 401(K) with a 6% company match
* 100% Employer-Paid Employee Only Medical Plan Option
* Employer Health Saving Account Contributions
* Two week’s vacation, one-week sick pay, and nine paid holidays

**What You’ll Do: Precision in Action**

**Strategic Operations Leadership**

* Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with organizational objectives, production requirements, and long-term business growth.
* Provide leadership and accountability across manufacturing, energetic operations, maintenance, and facilities ensuring effective coordination and operational performance.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery costs, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with site leadership to evaluate operational priorities, resource allocation, capital investments, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Manufacturing and Energetic Operations**

* Oversee production operations across Large Caliber Systems and Aerospace Propulsion business units ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant manufacturing activities.
* Provide strategic oversight of energetic material blending and processing operations, ensuring alignment with production requirements and established safety standards.
* Drive manufacturing performance through effective capacity planning workforce utilization production scheduling and operational discipline.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, supply chain, and program management to support customer commitments, resolve operational challenges, and improve manufacturing capabilities.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels and resource planning to meet programmatic needs while maintaining cost initiatives.
* Establish leader standard work directives to guide day-to-day operations.

**Maintenance and Facilities Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of maintenance operations including electrical and control systems, machining, mechanical maintenance, and equipment reliability.
* Lead facilities management functions supporting site infrastructure, facilities engineering, building systems, preventative maintenance, and essential site services.
* Establish and deconflict priorities for preventative maintenance, equipment availability, infrastructure improvements, and operational continuity.
* Support capital improvements, equipment upgrades, and facility investments necessary to sustain and expand manufacturing operations.

**Safety, Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Champion a safety-first culture ensuring operational adherence to applicable environmental health, explosive safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Quality to maintain process discipline, product conformity, risk management, and compliance with established management systems.
* Drive accountability for identifying and addressing operational risks, safety concerns, non-conformances, and continuous improvement opportunities.

**Financial Performance and People Leadership**

* Develop and manage operational budgets, labor resources, capital expenditures, and cost improvement initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop direct-report managers while establishing clear expectations for performance, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.Partner with People and Culture on workforce planning, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.

**What Dedicated Teammates Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration or related field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing operations or industrial leadership.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience including demonstrated success leading managers or multidisciplinary operational teams.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, energetic materials, chemical processing, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex manufacturing operations, develop operational strategies, manage budgets, and drive performance improvements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational excellence principles.
* Proven leadership, communication, problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Preferred Qualification:*

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management or related discipline.
* Direct experience in defense manufacturing, energetic material processing, ammunition production, or aerospace propulsion.
* Experience overseeing multiple operational functions including production, maintenance, facilities, and engineering support.
* Familiarity with explosive safety requirements and defense industry regulations.
* Experience with ISO 9001 and AS9100, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or comparable operational excellence methodologies.

*Leadership Competencies*

* Aligns operational capabilities and resources with business objectives and long-term growth.
* Drives performance improvements in safety, quality, delivery cost, and reliability.
* Build strong management teams and promotes accountability, engagement, and succession readiness.
* Demonstrate sound judgment, hazard awareness, and commitment to disciplined operations,
* Build effective partnerships across departments and business units
* Leads teams through expansion, organizational growth, and evolving operational requirements.

**Our Woking Conditions and Requirements**

* This position operates in both office and industrial manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with production areas, maintenance, operations, and facility infrastructure.
* The role may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and walking, including navigating manufacturing facilities and operational work areas.
* Employees must comply with applicable safety, security, and environmental requirements including the use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) when entering designated areas.
* The position may require occasional domestic or international travel and flexibility to support operational needs outside standard business hours.
* Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

*Our values are the fundamental principles guiding the way we do business and interact with stakeholders.*

***DEDICATION:*** *We are enthusiastic and creative, always searching for the best solutions.* 
***PRECISION:*** *We are reliable and accurate in our technology, processes and business.* 
***CARE:*** *We are inclusive and open-minded, always encouraging team spirit and cooperation.*

*Nammo and its subsidiaries provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

**\*\*Note\*\*: Due to US Export Control laws and regulations; applicants selected for employment must show proof of a U.S. Person status before employment may begin.**

new_roles.title: Supply Chain & Production Director
new_roles.description:
**Supply Chain & Production Director**

**Bil-Jax, Inc.**

**Location:** Archbold, Ohio (On-Site)

Note: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

 

**Bil-Jax, Inc., a member of the Haulotte Group, is seeking an experienced Supply Chain & Production Director to lead manufacturing and supply chain operations at our Archbold, Ohio facility.** Reporting directly to the Vice President & General Manager, this key leadership role is responsible for manufacturing, procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP). The successful candidate will lead a multi-year factory modernization initiative focused on automation, operational excellence, and scalable growth while partnering with production, engineering, sourcing, and commercial teams to improve productivity, delivery performance, and profitability across the business.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**Factory Modernization & Automation**

* Lead the development and execution of a long-term automation strategy that improves manufacturing efficiency, increases throughput, and reduces overall production costs.
* Manage capital investment projects from concept through implementation, including equipment selection, vendor management, installation, commissioning, and performance validation.
* Partner with Engineering and IT teams to integrate new manufacturing technologies and digital solutions that improve visibility, reporting, and operational decision-making.

 

**Production Planning & Operational Excellence**

* Optimize production scheduling and resource allocation across a complex manufacturing environment with approximately 2,000 active SKUs while maintaining high levels of quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Develop and implement processes that improve the flow of work-in-process material and eliminate bottlenecks between fabrication, welding, painting, and assembly operations.
* Lead the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process in collaboration with cross-functional leaders to align customer demand, production capacity, inventory levels, and business objectives.

 

**Supply Chain & Procurement Leadership**

* Develop sourcing strategies for steel, purchased components, and other critical materials while building strong supplier partnerships and mitigating supply chain risk.
* Establish inventory management practices that improve inventory accuracy, increase inventory turns, and maintain service levels required to support customers and production operations.
* Oversee warehousing, inbound logistics, and outbound freight activities to ensure efficient material flow and cost-effective distribution.

 

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Drive organizational change by leading the transition toward a more automated and technically advanced manufacturing environment while developing and upskilling existing team members.
* Provide leadership and direction to Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Production Supervisors, and other operational teams while working collaboratively with Maintenance, Safety, Shipping, and Site Leadership.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement by ensuring compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

 

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience within a manufacturing environment, including at least 5 years in a senior operations leadership role such as Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or Director of Operations.
* Demonstrated success within structural steel fabrication, sheet metal fabrication, machining, heavy equipment manufacturing, or a related industrial environment.
* Proven experience implementing manufacturing automation, robotics, or automated production cells.
* Experience leading operations within a manufacturing organization ranging from approximately $30M to $100M in annual revenue.
* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field.

 

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep understanding of metal fabrication, welding, machining, and assembly processes.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong financial and business acumen with experience managing operational budgets and capital expenditures.
* Experience utilizing ERP systems in a manufacturing environment, preferably Epicor.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and change management skills.

About the Position

We are an established architectural woodwork and custom millwork company based in Coconut Creek, Florida, seeking an experienced Production Manager / Shop Foreman to lead the day-to-day operations of our millwork shop.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, woodworking, and shop production.

You will be responsible for keeping production organized and moving—from approved drawings and materials through fabrication, assembly, quality control, and preparation for delivery and installation.

We are looking for someone who can lead people, organize workflow, maintain quality, solve production problems, and take ownership of the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily architectural millwork and cabinetry production
* Schedule and prioritize jobs based on project deadlines and installation requirements
* Assign work to shop employees and monitor production progress
* Read and interpret architectural drawings, shop drawings, elevations, details, and specifications
* Review drawings and materials before fabrication to identify missing information or potential production issues
* Coordinate closely with Project Managers regarding priorities, changes, field conditions, and project requirements
* Ensure materials, hardware, and components are available when required
* Oversee cutting, machining, fabrication, assembly, and preparation for delivery
* Maintain quality control throughout the production process
* Inspect completed work for dimensions, workmanship, drawings, specifications, and company standards
* Identify and resolve production problems quickly
* Coordinate with installation teams to ensure fabricated components are properly prepared for the field
* Track production schedules and communicate potential delays before they become critical
* Train, supervise, and hold shop personnel accountable for quality, productivity, and workmanship
* Maintain an organized, clean, and safe shop
* Improve shop workflow, organization, efficiency, and production processes
* Ensure completed millwork is properly labeled, protected, packaged, and ready for delivery
* Help maintain machinery, tools, equipment, and other shop resources
* Enforce company safety procedures and proper equipment use

Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of relevant experience in architectural millwork, custom cabinetry, woodworking, or a closely related trade
* Previous experience as a Shop Foreman, Production Manager, Millwork Foreman, Lead Carpenter, or similar leadership position
* Strong understanding of architectural millwork and custom fabrication
* Ability to read and interpret architectural plans and shop drawings
* Strong knowledge of woodworking materials, hardware, fabrication methods, and construction techniques
* Experience supervising and directing shop or production employees
* Strong understanding of quality control and professional millwork craftsmanship
* Ability to schedule and prioritize multiple projects and deadlines
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively with Project Managers, installers, vendors, and shop employees
* Ability to take ownership of shop operations and work independently
* Hands-on leadership style and willingness to work directly on the shop floor when needed

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* CNC machinery and CNC-based production
* Cabinet manufacturing
* Architectural woodwork
* High-end commercial or residential millwork
* Laminates, veneers, solid wood, and specialty materials
* Millwork hardware and specialty components
* Finishing and coordination with finishing vendors
* Cabinet Vision, AutoCAD, or similar software
* Production scheduling and job tracking systems
* Commercial construction and field installation coordination

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can run the shop—not simply supervise it.

The right person will know what is in production, what needs to be produced next, where potential problems exist, and what needs to happen to keep projects on schedule.

You should be comfortable leading employees while remaining actively involved on the shop floor.

Success in this position means maintaining an organized, productive shop that consistently produces high-quality millwork on schedule while minimizing mistakes, rework, and delays.

Compensation & Opportunity

* $80,000–$120,000 per year, depending on experience
* Bonus eligible
* Full-time position
* Stable, established architectural millwork company
* Opportunity for growth and increased responsibility
* Significant responsibility for shop operations and production
* Work on high-quality custom architectural millwork projects throughout South Florida

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through Indeed.

Candidates with direct architectural millwork or custom cabinetry experience should clearly identify that experience on their resume, including previous shop leadership responsibilities and the types of products or projects they have managed.

Pay: $95,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Director of Operations - Aiken, SC
new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Director of Operations is responsible for the activities of manufacturing, purchasing, quality, planning (supply chain), and project management of the organization and aids in formulating and administering organization policies.

#LI-SL1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Participating in formulating/administering company policies and developing long range goals/objectives.
* Directing/coordinating activities of the responsible departments on a day-to-day basis to ensure that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual objectives are met.
* Ensuring internal auditing for compliance with the ISO standards applicable.
* Driving cost reduction (productivity) planning and execution in accordance with the financial plan.
* Providing authorization for funds to ensure responsible fiduciary spending in accordance with financial policies.
* Reviewing/analyzing activities related to costs, operations, CAPEX, and forecast data to determine progress toward financial goals and objectives and considering the long-range impact of growing the business and adjusting actions to ensure compliance.
* Overseeing the budget/forecast processes as well as ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance.
* Conferring with other senior personnel to review achievements and discuss required changes in goals or objectives resulting from current status/conditions.
* Developing plans and executing actions to meet the decision upon actions.
* Providing oversight and coordination to other business in Operations related matters to drive consistency among the businesses.
* Participating in due diligence process as requested.
* Developing succession planning strategies in coordination with HR to ensure continuation of leadership/individual contributor roles going forward.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* Master’s Degree in Business Administration (required)
* 20+ years of relevant operations experience (required)
* 20+ years of experience as a Senior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or a similar role, preferably in a heavy manufacturing environment with multi-site responsibility
* 10+ years of experience with TPM and SAP
* Welding, Fabricating, Warehouse & Logistics experience
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing
* Staff development and engagement skills
* Bi-lingual Spanish/English preferred

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**

**Aerospace Manufacturing | Senior Leadership Team**

**About Columbia Manufacturing**

Columbia Manufacturing, a member of Collective Manufacturing Group, produces complex fabricated components and assemblies for leading aerospace and power generation engine programs. We are committed to delivering safe, reliable, and compliant products while fostering a culture built on integrity, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

**Contribute to Business Success**

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

**What We’re Looking For**

We recognize that great leaders come from many backgrounds. Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. Equivalent combinations of education, military training, trade experience, and hands-on manufacturing or quality leadership experience will be fully considered.

We are less concerned with how you gained your experience and more interested in your ability to lead people, interpret requirements, make sound decisions, and uphold quality standards under pressure.

Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, customer requirements, and specification interpretation.
* Demonstrated ethical leadership, sound decision-making, and the ability to uphold standards under pressure.
* Proven success leading teams and collaborating across departments.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with customers, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement mindset and practical problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards such as AS9100, AS9110, AS13100, NADCAP, or customer-specific requirements.
* Experience supporting OEM customers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, or similar organizations.
* Quality certifications or advanced education are valued but not required.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Quality Director plays a critical role in protecting our customers, our employees, and our reputation. This leader helps ensure that every product we build meets requirements and that every decision we make reflects our commitment to integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
new_roles.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, LCML Fulfillment Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About the Job**
-----------------

The Senior Manager, LCML Fulfillment Operations leads the end-to-end order fulfillment and distribution execution operating model for Carrier's Light Commercial (LCML) HVAC business within Climate Solutions Americas (CSA). Reporting to CSA Logistics & Supply Chain leadership, this role balances customer service reliability, on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery performance, inventory allocation governance, and fulfillment cost-to-serve productivity across North America.

This leader directs a team of fulfillment operations planners, order management specialists, and execution coordinators, steering initiatives in order backlog reduction, multi-site distribution throughput, order consolidation, and peak seasonal readiness. Working collaboratively with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Operations, Distribution Center (DC) Operations, Transportation, and Commercial Sales leadership, the Senior Manager establishes fulfillment KPIs and SLAs, enhances ERP/WMS/TMS data integrity, and champions continuous improvement across the order-to-delivery ecosystem.

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid: 3 days in office at the Atlanta Digital Hub, 2 days remote per week.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Fulfillment Execution & Planning Governance:** Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of fulfillment planners and execution coordinators managing day-to-day order allocation, scheduling, and customer delivery execution across North American distribution networks.
* **Network Throughput & Cost-to-Serve Productivity:** Drive order consolidation programs, warehouse/fulfillment cycle-time reductions, avoidable expedite elimination, and measurable cost-to-serve efficiencies across LCML distribution hubs.
* **Order Backlog & SLA Performance Management:** Own fulfillment scorecard reviews, OTIF delivery metrics, order-to-ship cycle times, and aged backlog governance. Partner with DC Operations and Transportation to optimize fulfillment capacity and SLA compliance.
* **Exception Management & Disruption Recovery:** Lead proactive operational recovery for critical customer delivery delays, inventory allocation constraints, capacity crunches, and seasonal demand surges.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner strategically with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Plants, Customer Service, and Commercial Sales leadership to align inventory positioning, product launch (NPI) fulfillment readiness, and customer lead-time commitments.
* **Digital Fulfillment & Systems Enhancement:** Enhance ERP, WMS, and TMS workflow standardization, end-to-end order visibility, automated milestone tracking, and digital executive KPI dashboards.
* **Continuous Improvement & Standard Work:** Implement standardized operating procedures (SOPs), daily tier accountability cadences, and root-cause problem solving (Lean, DMAIC, 5-Why) to sustain fulfillment gains and customer satisfaction.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or a business discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment operations, order management, distribution center operations, or domestic supply chain logistics.
* 5+ years of direct people leadership experience managing fulfillment planners, supervisors, dispatchers, or operations analysts.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Enterprise ERP, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), or Transportation Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP, Oracle, Blue Yonder/JDA, or Manhattan.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional supply chain or continuous improvement credentials such as APICS (CSCP, CPIM, CLTD) or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.
* Background in commercial/light commercial HVAC, industrial equipment manufacturing, or high-SKU seasonal distribution environments.
* Strong analytical aptitude with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel) and data-driven executive presentations.
* Willingness to travel domestically (approximately 15–25%) to regional distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and logistics operational hubs.

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $117,500.00 - $234,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
* **Tuition Assistance**

**To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us | Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process**

Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Carrier provides affirmative action in employment for qualified individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with section 503 of Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.

**Application Deadline**

Applications will be accepted for at least 3 days from Job Posting Date: 13 November 2026

**Job Applicant's Privacy Notice**

Please click on the link to review the Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

**Use of AI**

Technology-enabled tools may support parts of the recruitment process, with oversight by people.

new_roles.title: Regional Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Circle of Life is growing, and we have an opening for a Regional Director of Operations to join our team. This position will oversee and manage our New Mexico branches; Albuquerque, Gallup, Kirtland, Shiprock, and Zuni.

**Good for employees**

Circle of Life’s focus is creating a workplace where respect, appreciation and teamwork are the shared experiences of our team. We do good for our employees by collaborating on scheduling, a focus on wellbeing, a client-first directive, respecting and valuing every team member, having fun along with top industry compensation and benefits.

**Good deeds**

We also do good in our work. Our team of office and field staff care about each other and the clients we serve. We help one another. We care and provide for a wide range of patients with a focus on serving the underserved.

**Position duties include**

* Participate in the hiring and training of managers
* Organize and oversee the work and schedules of managers
* Conduct performance evaluations
* Handle discipline of employees as needed following company policy
* Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics, guidelines, and standards by which the company's efficiency and effectiveness can be evaluated (identify opportunities for improvement)
* Implement policies and procedures that will improve day-to-day operations
* Oversee office operations, ensuring each branch is reaching goals set by departmental and company leadership
* Monitors budget and revenue in each office to achieve financial objectives
* Communicates and explains new directives, policies/procedures to manager for change and meets with staff to explain changes, answer questions, and maintain morale
* Improve customer service and satisfaction
* Market current products to potential clients, families, case workers and potential referral sources
* Leads coordination and integration of efforts among homecare teams to produce smoother workflow and more cost-effective business processes
* Traveling is required

**Qualifications**

Qualified applicants will have 3 years of management experience, excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal and customer service skills. Healthcare and/or home care experience preferred. The Regional Director of Operations oversees the day-to-day activities for their assigned branches, ensuring the organization is managed and performing efficiently and effectively. While carrying out the responsibilities of the position, ensure the values of servant-leadership, empathy, altruism, and integrity are evident in all actions and encounters.

**How good?**

* Positively change the lives of individuals and families in our communities
* Serve the underserved providing access to care for those who have been traditionally overlooked by the health care system
* Support a talented team of administrative and clinical professionals and be a part of a team that supports each other

**Full Benefits include**

* Medical, Dental, 401K, Paid Holidays, Top PTO Plan, Mileage, Flexible Schedules, Vision, Year-End Bonus

new_roles.title: Director of Operations homecare
new_roles.description:
Royal Faith Homecare Agency is seeking an organized, compassionate, and motivated professional to coordinate caregiver, schedules, maintain reliable client coverage, support agency growth through marketing, community outreach, and referral development.The Director of Operations, Homecare, leads the systems and teams that support safe, reliable care in patients’ homes. You’ll guide operational and strategic management, align resources with organizational priorities, and partner across clinical and administrative functions. Your impact: By strengthening care operations and performance improvement, you help patients and families receive coordinated, dependable homecare.

The ideal candidate will have strong adminstrative and communication skills, understand the importance of dependable home care services, and feel comfortable building relationships with healthcare professionals, social workers, case managers, and community organizations.

As a Home Director Of Operations, you’ll help clients access organized, responsive care by coordinating communication, records, and administrative support. You’ll manage client information with care, assist with scheduling and inquiries, and help ensure documentation follows applicable health regulations and privacy requirements. Your impact: By keeping care details accurate and communication clear, you help clients and care teams stay informed and better prepared for each step of service.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate client inquiries, appointments, and care-related administrative tasks.

* Care Coordination and Scheduling

* create and maintain weekly caregiver schedules

* Match Caregivers with clients based on qualifications, availability, and client needs.

* Handle call-outs, missed shifts, late arrivals, and replacement coverage.

* Communicate schedule changes to clients, caregivers and authorized representative

* monitor scheduled, completed, missed, and cancelled visits.

* Track authorized service hours and notify management of discrepancies.

* Monitor authorization expiration dates and alert the appropriate staff.

* Communicate with clients and care teams by phone and other appropriate channels; route questions to the right person.

Marketing and Community Outreach

* Promote Royal Faith Homecare Agency's approved services to appropriate referral sources.

* Visit hospitals, rehabilitation facilities, medical offices, senior centers, veteran-serving organizations, and community organization.

* Build professional relationships with social workers, discharge planners, case managers, and other referral partners.

* Explain the agency Veteran, Private Pay homecare services and referral process accurately.

* Distribute approved brochures, business cards, and marketing materials.

* Assist with community events, networking meetings, and outreach campaigns.

Skills

* Medical office or general office experience; medical administrative support experience is helpful.

* Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR) and EHR management, patient management software, and Microsoft Office.

* Knowledge of medical terminology, health insurance, and health regulation policies is preferred.

* Strong customer service, phone communication, and client communication skills.

* Accurate typing, attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.

**Duties**

* Lead daily homecare operations, setting priorities and monitoring service quality, compliance, and operational performance.
* Direct managers and teams, building accountability through clear managerial communication, team leadership, and executive leadership.
* Partner with medical and nursing leaders on care delivery, staffing, and medical management.
* Lead Performance Improvement (PI) initiatives and collaborate cross-functionally to address operational challenges and support strategic goals.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience in healthcare management, operations management, and operational management, including leadership of teams and managers.
* Nursing leadership experience and a background in medical leadership or medical management are important for guiding homecare services.
* Knowledge of health regulation policy and Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations (JCAHO) standards, with the ability to apply requirements to operations.
* Strong strategic management, executive leadership, team leadership, and managerial communication skills.
* Ability to manage healthcare finances and work effectively across clinical, administrative, and operational functions.

Pay: From $19.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oxford, AL 36203

new_roles.title: Director, Operations
new_roles.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! 
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Does the thought of joining one of the fastest-growing, privately held data center companies sound exciting to you? Do you enjoy collaborating with team members to drive and operate some of the industry’s leading and most innovative infrastructure solutions?

At **Aligned Data Centers**, not only do we celebrate success across our platform, we celebrate the very teams that drive and support that success! Our culture is founded in passion, engineered from innovation, and driven by the pursuit of operational excellence. We are a company dedicated to driving positive change in the industry through continuous data center innovation, diversity and inclusion, and corporate sustainability.

We realize not only is providing a comprehensive benefits package important, but we also provide a generous 401k match with immediate vesting, free membership to Gympass which provides our employees a rich health and wellness benefit and competitive time off plan. Giving back and having fun is important to our team whether it be serving our communities or employee and customer events. ***Our Aligned DNA is what makes us unique and successful!***

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Director Operations is responsible for leading and executing all aspects of the campus operations to include safety, security, reliability, network environment, customer relations, the critical environment, and P&L. This role will strategize, manage, and operate multiple Datacenter facilities for Aligned. 
The Director of Operations will ensure all Datacenter facility systems meet or exceed industry standards for critical maintenance resulting in 100% uptime, ensures the building engineering and security teams follow all reporting and documentation processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and meets all customer service level agreements and compliance audits. The Director of Operations will serve as the liaison for all 24x7 operational activities across their managed facilities with executives and department heads to ensure appropriate communications with all interested and vested parties. They will lead and direct the staff in their market to optimize employee potential and maximize Aligned’s continued growth in existing and new markets. This role reports to the SVP of Operations or their designee.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provides senior leadership to drive strategic vision for Aligned’s datacenters, including Critical Facilities Operations, Preventative Maintenance, Commissioning, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Security, Logistics, and Safety on a Senior level.
* Manages Campus operations of the 24x7 Datacenter environment. Identifies and implements critical metrics necessary to manage and monitor the performance of overall operations including, but not limited to, capacity, availability, budget, and inventory. Oversees all electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as UPS systems, generators, fire suppression systems, BMS, and HVAC systems Has responsibility for meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Ensures that all work performed within the Datacenter is done to high quality and without impact to any internal/external customers.
* Oversees requirements and delivery of services provided by Operations, Security, and Safety. Drives maximum potential of these functions to provide exceptional services to clients and employees.
* Oversees and supports the level 5 commissioning, operations, and maintenance of all Datacenter mission critical infrastructure in order to achieve 100% availability. Manages Datacenter facility expansion and consolidation.
* Manages, coaches, and develops management team performing Datacenter operations.
* Manages and leads vendor relationship to maintain day to day operations and strategic goals for Datacenter Operations SLA’s and deliverables. Works with current vendor stakeholders and partners to develop and deliver strategic plans. Oversees all Datacenter vendor contracts, streamlining services required and optimizing overall costs.
* Will work closely with all strategic supply chain vendors to ensure Aligned’s lean management strategies and continuous innovation and process improvement are fully implemented.
* Evaluates and mitigates risk on new and existing programs within datacenter program governance.
* Develops opportunities for cross-team effectiveness and remove organizational barriers for strong teamwork, collaboration, and excellent service delivery.
* Drives Aligned’s Sustainability Strategy and creates a program to improve the efficiency of the Datacenter operations.
* Engages in improvement projects, which often requires reaching out to a variety of support teams and driving them from conception to completion.
* Manages budgeting and forecasting, planning, deployment, incident and problem management, change management.
* Maintains documentation and diagrams capturing all essential parameters of Datacenter operations.
* Defines policies, procedures, and standards related to performance, capacity, availability, continuity, and security.
* Creates and delivers presentations to leadership team, company meetings, and conferences.
* Will meet all customer service levels and power utilization efficiency commitments and take an active role in on-going customer interaction. Participate in customer service review discussion and various ad-hoc meetings related to Datacenter management issues.
* Manages customer service orders and remote hand requests.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors, and customers.
* Ensure compliance with all safety procedures as well as utilization of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Respond quickly and appropriately to emergency situations (i.e., fire, evacuation, equipment failure etc.) and any customer concerns.
* Ensures inventory control programs/purchase parts and supplies are maintained.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, requisitions, government agencies and AE directives as relates to building and critical environment operations.
* Operational Roles may also apply as necessary.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred with 10 years’ experience or minimum of 12-15 years of related experience in lieu of degree.

* Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex project documents, AutoCAD, Visio, and PDF documents.
* Ability to project and time manage effectively.
* Ability to develop operational standards, project tracking, and management documents.
* Ability to effectively respond, verbally or written, to sensitive issues, complex inquiries, or complaints.
* Ability to make effective presentations and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.
* Requires a high level of commitment to customer service, whether co-workers or clients.
* Requires in-depth knowledge of all applicable rules, laws, codes, regulations, and ordinances in performing data/communications and MEP projects.
* Ability to estimate cost of client installations and other assigned projects. Cost tracking for all projects.
* Knowledge of Purchase Order Requests process and invoice tracking.
* Develops appropriate RFP processes in addition to development of operating and capital budgets.
* Ability to analyze and solve problems involving several options with limited information.
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form and to work independently.
* Demonstrate ability to work well under pressure with a proactive approach to unusual occurrences.
* Requires good organizational skills, attention to detail and an openness to new ideas and procedures.
* MSOffice applications. i.e., Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Occasional travel will be required for training and meetings.

**BENEFITS & PERKS:**

Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Eligible employees have access to:

* **Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* **Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts:** HSA with employer contribution for eligible participants. FSA's offered for health and dependent care to increase tax savings.
* **Retirement Savings**: 401(k) plan with company match
* **Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay**
* **Company-Sponsored Insurance**: Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability (with medical election)
* **Optional Benefits**: Voluntary life, critical illness, legal, and additional disability coverage
* **Wellness Programs**: Employee assistance program (EAP), Wellhub gym membership, and other wellness initiatives

*The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.*

*At Aligned, we are committed to transparency and fostering a positive employee experience from your very first interaction with us. In compliance with Illinois pay disclosure requirements, when you join Aligned, you’ll have access to the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short and long disability, life insurance and other voluntary benefits, 401k with employer match, bonus opportunities, paid time off, wellness benefits and professional development opportunities, all designed to support your well-being and career growth. We want you to have a clear understanding of what we offer, so you can make informed decisions about your future with us.*

*Aligned is equally committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities for all employees. We ensure that all applicants and team members are considered for employment, advancement, and all other employment-related matters without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

*If you require a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of your job due to a disability or medical condition, please contact our People & Culture team. new_roles.title: Operational Excellence Director
new_roles.description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We're adding to our team! We are seeking an **Operational Excellence****Director** to lead the optimization of workflows and play a key role in the continuous improvement across all projects and operations. This role ensures alignment with industry best practices, including CSIA Best Practices, while driving consistent, high-quality delivery in automation and integration projects.

**You will:**

* Ensure workflows meet E Tech Group and Business Unit quality policies, procedures, CSIA Best Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits to evaluate adherence to standards, practical efficiency of associated tools, assess root-cause failure modes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
* Business Unit representative for E Tech's Continuous Improvement Committee, providing practical suggestions and solutions, communicating with Business Unit leadership.
* Analyze project execution workflows to identify and remove bottlenecks, directly improving project lead times and margin predictability.
* Identify and champion the use of digital tools and AI to automate repetitive administrative tasks, reducing 'process friction' for engineering teams.
* Represent the Business Unit for Customer and third party audits, including audit preparation, participation, response coordination, and follow up.
* Foster quality, consistency, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional teams.
* Support Corporate Continuous Improvement initiatives including development and review of policies and procedures.
* Lead Business Unit continuous improvement activities.
* Provide necessary supplemental training and guidance to the Business Unit on quality standards, procedures, and expectations.
* Provide support to improve the quality and effectiveness of the Learning Management System (LMS)
* Encourage collaboration, shared learning, and knowledge transfer across teams throughout the Company
* Collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, and the Project Management Organization to support project risk assessments, and quality planning.
* Attend project reviews, as needed, and provide guidance to project teams for compliance with Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and other procedures during project execution.
* Interface with clients and third parties on quality related topics, including audits, vendor qualification, and compliance inquiries.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical or Systems), or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Over seven years of experience in process improvement and engineering performance within technical, project-driven settings. Proven track record in supporting process optimization, waste reduction, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives in engineering or project environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders
* Experience working in automation, life sciences or other regulated industries, prefer knowledge of ISO 9001, GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Assurance (CSA).
* Experience supporting automation and control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI).
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
* Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
* Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

Salary Range: $150,000-$170,000

*E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.*

*#LI-HY1*
